authenticity_review: The image exhibits high-quality glass rendering with realistic refraction and lighting. Additionally, the feet of the second monkey from the left show minor fusion with the branch surface. The pose auditor's high artifact risk score (0.46) correlates with slight anatomical vagueness in the hands and toes, which blend into the glass texture rather than having crisp definition. These defects prevent a perfect authenticity score.
